name: Enotria: The Last Song - Deluxe Edition
storyline: In this world, the Universe itself is a Story, one that unfolds and weaves the ever-changing tapestry of reality. That is, until a group of extraordinary individuals used the power of the Story to trap it on paper, creating the Canovaccio. Since then, the world has degraded, becoming an empty yet beautiful husk of what it once was.
summary:
